connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: Three ganged, normally open disconnector contact pairs. Opting in asserts author-selected disconnector-function identity. Isolation suitability (impulse withstand, contact gap, position indication, lockability), load-break and ratings are not asserted. Optional: pole use by application; require both ends of each used pole. No universal required points. Unmodeled: neutral, bonding, auxiliary contacts, operation means, handle/lock and isolation indication. Safety performance must be selected/reviewed by the author. Pole markings follow the existing core line/load convention; L/T mean line/load side, not phase or polarity. No manufacturer pinout or protective trip is asserted.
